column1: # Every entry of the retail (Steam) 1.03 patch.dat: its name hash, then the XxHash64 of its
# decompressed bytes. LegacyPatchImporter skips a legacy entry identical to its retail version: the
# mod was built on it, even where an install ships another patch (GOG). Regenerate from a clean
# Steam install's patch.fat/patch.dat with DuniaArchive and System.IO.Hashing.XxHash64.
